title: Today tab: saved recipes first, plus a Try something new entry
summary: The first tab is Today with a calendar icon, and the saved-recipe collection is Recipes. Today shows a device-local greeting, saved picks and Try something new behind existing readiness gates. Suggested recipe review uses one row: filled Save, secondary Edit/Preview and ghost Rerun, with unchanged actions and guards. The collection keeps one pushed root and Add/import owner, Add and timer chrome on exactly two roots, and Search preserves the stack. Native final-head compile and device screenshots remain UNRUN.
